prose: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said on the company's Q3 2026 earnings call that Muse, Meta's AI agent app, has attracted more than 10 million users since launch, and that over a quarter of them are making purchases through the app with an average purchase size above $200. The figures are an early signal that Meta's push into agentic commerce is converting engagement into transactions at meaningful ticket sizes.
highlights: Zuckerberg: Muse AI agent app has 10M+ users since launch
25%+ of Muse users make purchases through the app
Disclosed on Meta's Q3 2026 earnings call
Basis: source cache thin (paywall stub); summary built from the Techmeme feed blurb of Business Insider reporting.
